title: Expose sales-invoice evidence in customer reconciliation workflows
description: Extend existing Sales Order and ERP-046 customer reconciliation workflows with read-only sales-invoice allocation evidence from ERP-055 and receipt-reference evidence from ERP-053. Keep ordered, shipped, invoiced and receipt-reference amounts distinct and do not calculate or claim an accounts-receivable balance, tax liability, settlement result, due date or aging bucket. Do not infer links, mutate source records, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Sales Order detail exposes active allocated customer sales-invoice evidence, invoice count and unallocated or unavailable context using only persisted ERP-055 allocation rows.
Sales Order lists expose a bounded sales-invoice evidence summary without issuing a database query per row.

The ERP-046 reconciliation workflow displays ordered, shipment, sales-invoice and customer-receipt allocation evidence in separate labeled fields and never nets them into an asserted accounts-receivable balance.

Amounts are grouped or displayed by currency and different currencies are never combined, converted or reassigned without an authoritative persisted conversion that is already part of the source record.
Draft and voided invoice evidence is distinguished from active recorded evidence; voided evidence is excluded from active totals but remains inspectable historically.
Customer or currency mismatches in historical invoice or receipt evidence are displayed as invalid or unavailable and are not silently merged with compatible evidence.
Missing invoice or receipt evidence is shown as none or unknown and is never converted into uninvoiced tax liability, unpaid, paid, settled, outstanding or overdue status.

The UI and documentation state that the workflow is an operational evidence view, not an accounts-receivable ledger, legal Customer statement, tax filing report, payment authorization, settlement result or aging statement.
The workflow is read-only and does not update invoices, Sales Orders, shipment records, receipt evidence, Customer credit state, commissions, inventory, finance or tax records.
Queries are bounded or paged, avoid per-row database access and reuse ERP-046, ERP-053, ERP-054 and ERP-055 authoritative semantics rather than implementing another reconciliation engine.

Unit/integration tests cover no evidence, full and partial invoice allocation, receipt evidence, void history, mismatched historical evidence, multiple Customers and currencies, bounded queries and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open a Sales Order with partial shipment, sales-invoice allocation and customer-receipt allocation evidence and verify all evidence classes remain separately labeled in one currency.
Inspect an order with draft, voided, mismatched or missing invoice evidence and verify it is not presented as taxable, paid, settled, outstanding or overdue and that no source record changes.

human_gate.reason: Read-only presentation of repository invoice and receipt evidence. No invoice issuance, tax submission, accounting posting, real settlement, production mutation, deployment or release is authorized.
